product.name: Futura Toilet Seat Soft Close Sage D Shape, Premium Thermoplastic, Quick Release, Easy Clean, Top & Bottom Fixings
product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Futura Sage D-Shaped Soft Close Toilet Seat, made from durable premium thermoplastic for everyday use. Designed to fit most standard D-shaped toilet pans measuring 42.5cm x 36cm, it features adjustable hinges, top and bottom fixing options, a one-button quick release function and a soft close mechanism to help prevent slamming. Hygienic, easy to clean and ideal for adding a soft sage finish to your bathroom.

IMPORTANT – PLEASE CHECK YOUR TOILET DIMENSIONS BEFORE ORDERING

This D-shaped toilet seat measures approximately 425mm long × 360mm wide, with an internal seat opening of approximately 280mm long × 212mm wide.

The adjustable fittings are suitable for toilet pans with fixing holes positioned 60mm to 195mm apart, measured centre-to-centre.

To check compatibility, measure from the exact centre of one fixing hole in your toilet pan to the exact centre of the other fixing hole. Do not measure from the outside edges of the holes or from the existing hinge covers.

Required fixing hole spacing: 60–195mm centre-to-centre.

If your toilet fixing holes are less than 60mm or more than 195mm apart centre-to-centre, this seat will not be suitable.

Please check both the overall seat dimensions and fixing-hole spacing against your toilet before ordering.

product.name: John Guest Speedfit Push Fit Reducer 22mm x 15mm - Pack of 3 for Easy Plumbing Connections
product.description:
Upgrade your plumbing with the John Guest Speedfit Push Fit Reducer, designed for seamless connections between plastic and copper pipes. This innovative fitting features a reduced spigot end that allows you to join two Speedfit push-fit fittings effortlessly, creating a flexible swivel connection while minimizing line size. Installation is a breeze – simply push the fitting onto the pipe and twist the plastic nut clockwise to secure it in place. When you need to disconnect, just unlock the nut by hand, push the collet towards the fitting body, and pull the pipe to release. 

Each pack contains 3 high-quality reducers, which are up to 40% faster to install compared to traditional plumbing methods. Perfect for tight spaces, this tool-free solution eliminates the need for hot works, making it a safer option for any plumbing job. 

Key Features:
- Instant push-fit connection for quick installation
- Tool-free demounting in seconds
- Safe flame-free installation with no heat, glue, or flux required
- Grip & Seal collet with stainless steel teeth and main O-Ring seal for a secure fit
- Twist & Lock mechanism provides added compression
- Non-toxic, corrosion-resistant, and prevents scale build-up
- Compatible with Speedfit PEX and polybutylene plastic pipes (inserts required) as well as copper pipes
- Suitable for both hot and cold water applications and central heating systems

Designed, manufactured, and assembled in the UK, this Speedfit reducer fitting is the perfect choice for efficient and reliable plumbing solutions.

product.name: 10x1.3mm Evoh x 15mm Plastic Adapter for Water Underfloor Heating Evoh Pipe and Pert-Al Pert and Pex Pipe PSWTRADESUPPLIERS
product.description:
PSW TRADESUPPLIERS LTD offers high quality products.
The Repair Coupler offers a quick and simple solution for fixing damaged sections of underfloor heating pipes, making it an essential component for maintaining efficient hydronic heating systems. This repair joint securely connects two sections of pipe, ensuring a watertight seal and preventing leaks.

Each coupler includes an olive and double O-ring rubber seal, guaranteeing a reliable and secure finish every time. Specifically designed for multilayer Pert-Al-Pex-Al pipes or PEX Pipe, the joiner consists of an insert with O-ring seals, a split olive, and a nut for enhanced durability and ease of installation.

Over time, pipe joints may suffer damage from wear and tear, high pressure, or improper installation, leading to potential leaks and reduced heating efficiency. The repair process is straightforward and does not require special tools. It involves shutting off the water supply, draining the system, removing the damaged pipe section, and installing a new section using the repair joint.

This versatile and user-friendly repair coupler is compatible with various pipe types, including PEX, Pert, and CPVC, ensuring smooth and efficient repairs for underfloor heating systems.

product.name: Toilet Tank Bank Flush Cistern Insert Water Saving Device
product.description:
The toilet tank bank is designed to be filled with water and inserted into your toilet cistern.
This means that when the toilet is flushed the cistern never empties fully and thus you save water as less water travels back into the cistern after flushing.
Ideal for older cisterns in particular which can have a flush level of between 9 and 12 litres the toilet tank bank is made from non-corrosive materials that resist microbes and fungal growth.
One toilet tank bank can take up to 2 litres of water and it has a air lock fill valve so that no water ever evaporates and thus you never have to refill the bank making it a maintenance free product.
The product also includes a clip for attaching to the side wall of the cistern so that it fits neatly in place and won't float around the cistern and get caught in the toilet mechanisms.

How to Use the Toilet Tank Bank:
1: Fill with water and close cap
2: Open cistern cover
3: Flush toilet
4: Place your toilet tank bank in position cliping onto the side wall of cistern. Ensure that it won't interfere with the ballcock or order mechanism in the cistern
5: Replace cistern cover and start to save water

product.description:
Hozelock 1583 Aquaforce 6000 Garden Pond Pump and Filter

The Aquaforce 6000 is an extremely efficient filter and waterfall pump.
The Aquaforce case incorporates an exclusive wildlife protection system; protecting small fish, newts and frogs from accessing the pump.
The Wildlife Protection System reduces the risk of damage to common pond wildlife. For extra protection of species such as newts we recommend using an additional cage, available as a spare part.

Key Features:
Conical impeller - maximises performance
Self Cooling System - gives continuously perfect conditions
Ceramic Bearings - maximise pump life
Large cage surface area reduces cage clogging  improves water purity
Wildlife Protection System - protects small fish, newts, frogs, etc from accessing the pump
Carry handle - easy lifting in and out of the pond

How does Aquaforce work 

Pond water is drawn in through the cage grill which filters out coarse solids up to 6mm/10mm in size (dependent on model). Smaller particles down to 2mm in size can be eliminated by fitting the supplied clip-in fine mesh filter tray which affords the best possible protection for pond fish, preventing them from accessing the pump.

The Aquaforce has a considerably increased cage surface area, which allows the maximum amount of waste to be collected and pumped to the filter system. It also means that the cage is far less likely to clog, which will save you from constant cleaning.

Hozelock 5m Pond Hose

Made from high quality plastics this spiral hose is extremely flexible with a bend radius only 3 times its diameter without kinking or splitting.

product.name: Garland Budget Propagator with Drainage Holes - Small, 23cm Seed Tray for Windowsills
product.description:
Get your seeds off to a strong start with the Garland Small Budget Propagator, a practical and affordable solution for home seed germination. Maintaining the correct moisture level is essential for successful germination, and the drainage system helps protect delicate seedlings from excess water during their early stages of growth.

A lightweight clear vacuum-formed lid helps retain warmth and humidity around your seeds, creating a consistent environment that encourages quicker germination and stronger development. The transparent cover also allows plenty of natural light to reach your seedlings while making it easy to monitor progress without disturbing the growing conditions.

Manufactured in the UK, this compact propagator is ideal for windowsills, conservatories, greenhouses and other small growing spaces. Measuring 23cm long, 17cm wide and 12.5cm high, it is perfectly sized for raising a variety of seedlings while taking up minimal space.

Whether you are starting a vegetable garden, growing herbs indoors or raising bedding plants for the season ahead, the Garland Small Budget Propagator offers a simple, reliable and environmentally conscious way to achieve better germination results.

Rainwater Butt Diverter Set for waterbutts
Diverters are additional fittings that can be attached to your home downpipe to provide a direct connection to your water butt.

Designed to collect some rainwater diverting the rainwater into your waterbutt. The diverter connector kit uses a tube straight into your water butt with the ability to control any overflow when your water butt is full.

Waterbutt Connector Fixing Kit: Allows easy collection of rainwater from your downpipe. Prevents the water butt from over filling when it is full. Connects downpipe to the rain barrel.

Perfect for your garden or allotment allowing water to be easily accessed when needed.

This waterbutt hose kit set includes; 1x rain diverter, 1x hose connector, 1x flexible hose pipe, 1x washer and 1x fixing nut.

Divert rain from your downpipe to your rain barrel fits the majority of downpipes used in the home, including square and round types. Once the water butt is full (if properly fitted) the water butt will not overflow but the water will continue to flow down the downpipe.

FEATURES
Downpipe Rainwater Diversion Kit.
Suitable for both round and square downpipes
Made of sturdy black plastic
Easy to install
Great water saver
Made in the UK

Using a rainwater diverter is a great way to save on costs and time on refilling, reduce your impact on the environment and maintain a supply of free and readily available water for use around the home and garden.

PERFECT FOR FITTING A WATERBUTT TO:
Small garages, Greenhouses / Garden buildings, Sheds & Summerhouses and will fit either 68mm square or 65mm round PVC Downpipe Rainwater Pipes

product.name: Shower Seal for Screens Doors or Panels, Fits 4, 5 or 6mm Glass, Seals Gaps Up to 3mm, 1400mm Length, SEAL053
product.description:
This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 4mm to 6mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible bubble which will seal any gap from 1mm to 3mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

If you're struggling to find the correct seal for your shower/bath screen then please don't hesitate to get in contact with us. We would be more than happy to help.

product.name: Reliance AR18 Aquasystem 18 Litre 3.5 Bar 3/4 MI Potable Expansion Vessel with Hose & Service Valve XVES 050 051
product.description:
Includes

- 18 Litre Potable Expansion Vessel
- 1m Expansion Vessel Hose 3/4″ M x F
- Tesla 3/4″ Expansion Vessel Service Valve For Potable Vessels

All Aquasystem expansion vessels are supplied with a replaceable membrane, which separates the water and air, to prevent contamination of the water system, corrosion of the expansion vessel or pressure loss in the water system.

The main purpose of an expansion vessel is to compensate for the increase in volume of water due to the varying water temperatures in hot water or heating systems. When water is heated it expands and as water is not compressible this increased volume will create a rise in pressure within the system. As an example, water being heated from 0°C-100°C will increase by approx 4.5%.

The expansion vessel allows for this extra space, as when water temperature increases the membrane inside the vessel inflates to allow the water to fill the vessel. The membrane will continue to expand until the system reaches its maximum temperature. Once this has been reached the membrane will be fully inflated and takes up the capacity of the vessel shell. Gradually the temperature will drop, which will in turn decrease the volume of water. Due to the pressure from the pressurised air surrounding the membrane, water will start to exit the vessel until the membrane is deflated.

product.name: 3/4 BSP Water Butt Fitting with Full Flow PP Valve and 20mm MDPE Fitting
product.description:
MDPE (Medium-Density Polyethylene) fittings are essential components in piping systems, specifically designed for connecting MDPE pipes. Known for their durability, flexibility, and chemical resistance, MDPE fittings are widely used in applications such as water supply, irrigation, and industrial processes. These fittings, feature threaded compression connections that ensure a tight, leak-free seal without the need for specialized equipment, making them both cost-effective and easy to install. 
An MDPE straight connector is a type of pipe fitting used to join two pieces of piping or tubing in a straight line, without any angle or deviation. It's a simple yet essential component in plumbing, fluid transport, and various other applications where a direct, uninterrupted connection between two pipes is needed.
MDPE PN10 pipe fittings are engineered to withstand a maximum pressure of 10 bars (approximately 145 psi), ensuring the integrity of the piping system under various conditions. These fittings are not only durable, capable of withstanding harsh weather and mechanical stress, but also resistant to corrosion from chemicals and acids, which contributes to their longevity and reduces maintenance needs. Overall, MDPE fittings provide a reliable, versatile, and efficient solution for a wide range of piping applications.

product.name: Aluminium Beaded Hose Connector for Silicone Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes (57mm OD, 600mm Long)
product.description: Our Beaded Aluminium Hose Joiners (Swaged Connectors) provide a robust and professional solution for joining hoses in high-pressure or high-temperature applications. The lightweight yet strong aluminium construction resists corrosion and performs reliably in both automotive and industrial environments. These joiners are ideal for use in turbocharger systems, intercoolers, radiators, and custom intake/exhaust setups. Compatible with silicone, rubber, and other flexible hoses, they maintain a strong grip when used with standard hose clamps. The smooth internal bore promotes optimal airflow or fluid transfer without turbulence or restriction. Available in a wide range of diameters from 13mm to 102mm, offering easy integration into custom pipework setups. Whether you're repairing, upgrading, or building a new system, these connectors deliver strength, reliability, and clean aesthetics for a polished result

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses Straight Reinforced Hose High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator (Black - 850mm)
product.description: Our Silicone Straight Joiner Couplers (SSC) offer a high-performance solution for connecting pipes in coolant, air, water, and turbo systems. Available in internal diameters from 6 mm up to 152 mm and lengths from 50 mm to 950 mm, they cover everything from compact engine bays to large industrial installations. Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.name: 40mm 10 Metre Black Aquatic/Fishpond Filter, Pump or Waterfall Flexible Reinforced Hose/Pipe With 2 Free Hose Clips Clamps

With excellent resistance to algae growth inside the hose and a smooth internal bore to promote efficient water circulation, this flexible reinforced pipe is an essential piece of equipment for every pond owner. Designed for convenience, strength, and longevity, it offers peace of mind and dependable performance season after season.

product.name: Pegdev - PDL - Detectable Underground Warning Tape Sewer Pumping Main 150mm - Traceable Marker Tape Stainless Steel Wires (9M)

product.name: 16mm 90 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Blue Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 90 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is designed to provide a reliable and leak-free connection between hoses where space is limited or where a sharp change in direction is required. Manufactured from durable Blue ABS plastic, this connector offers strength and longevity, making it ideal for a wide range of water applications. The barbed design ensures a secure grip on the hose, reducing the risk of leaks and slippage, even under water pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, and water pipes, this connector is resistant to weathering, corrosion, and impact, ensuring it can withstand outdoor conditions throughout the year. The 90-degree elbow shape makes it particularly useful in tight spaces, preventing kinks and maintaining smooth water flow. Whether you are connecting hoses for garden irrigation systems, pond filtration setups, aquariums, or general water transfer projects, this versatile connector delivers dependable performance. Lightweight yet robust, it is easy to install by simply pushing the hose ends over the barbs for a firm, watertight seal. Designed for convenience and efficiency, it helps maintain neat and effective hose routing in your setup. A simple but essential accessory for gardeners, pond keepers, and DIY enthusiasts, this connector is a cost-effective solution for keeping your water systems running smoothly and efficiently with minimal maintenance.

product.name: 28mm 20 Metre Clear Aquatic/Fishpond Filter, Pump or Waterfall Flexible Reinforced Hose/Pipe, Drainage Hose for Pools and Hot Tubs
product.description: This Clear PVC Corrugated Hose is a durable and flexible solution for moving water, air, or light chemicals. Designed with a smooth internal wall for efficient flow and a tough corrugated outer layer for added strength and flexibility, it’s ideal for pond systems, water pumps, filtration, and general fluid transfer. The clear design allows easy visual inspection of contents, while the UV-resistant construction makes it suitable for outdoor use. Reinforced with a high-tensile plastic rib, this hose maintains excellent structural integrity under pressure and resists kinking even when bent to tight radii. It performs in temperatures from -10°C to +65°C, with peak resistance up to +70°C. Available in sizes from 19mm to 50mm inner diameter, it supports working pressures up to 5 Bar and burst pressures up to 15 Bar depending on the size. Coils are supplied in 30m or 50m lengths, offering efficient installation for large or small setups. Manufactured to BS EN ISO 3994-2001, this hose delivers long-term reliability in commercial, industrial, or garden environments.

product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

product.name: Polypipe PolyPlumb PB6315 15mm Bend Former - 5 Pack
product.description:
PolyPlumb is a traditional push-fit plumbing, tried and tested, grey plumbing system. Robust and reliable, PolyPlumb has stood the test of time. PolyPlumb fittings feature a one step jointing process and a high performance stainless steel grab ring within the fitting, ensuring superb joint integrity. Use PolyPlumb with Polypipe grey polybutylene flexible pipe, or you can combine PolyPlumb fittings and copper pipe. We recommend the use of a Polypipe metal or plastic pipe stiffener when used with plastic pipe.

PolyPlumb is suitable for use in most plumbing and heating installations including hot and cold water and underfloor heating applications. The system offers a high degree of reliability, achieved through a product design that has been tried and tested over the past 30 years.

The Polyplumb system is not suitable for the transportation of gases.

Polyplumb Range Benefits
Original grey plumbing system, using tried and tested technology for many years
PolyPlumb provides a superb combination of fast fitting with a permanent, reliable fix
PolyPlumb offers a one-step jointing process, with joint integrity assured by a high performance
stainless steel grab ring
Demountable by dis-assembly only
Use for all hot and cold water supply or heating applications, including under floor heating
Use with Polypipe grey polybutylene pipe systems or copper pipe
Use Polypipe metal or plastic pipe stiffeners

product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Low Profile Shower Tray with High Flow Waste (1000 x 760mm), a lightweight and durable solution ideal for modern bathrooms, en-suites and low-level installations. Its versatile rectangular design fits a wide range of shower enclosures, making it a practical choice for both new builds and renovations.

Made in the UK, this shower tray is constructed from acrylic capped ABS, offering excellent strength while being significantly lighter than traditional stone resin trays. Tested to support up to 4000kg, it delivers long-lasting performance while remaining easy to handle and install.

The slim 45mm low profile height creates a sleek, contemporary look and improves accessibility. Designed with flexibility in mind, the tray can be cut to size to suit awkward spaces or bespoke layouts (cut edges must be sealed to prevent water ingress).

Supplied with a 90mm high flow waste, it efficiently drains water at up to 32 litres per minute, helping to prevent pooling during use. The waste includes a standard 40mm connection and offset elbow for easier installation.

product.name: Aveli Raised 760 x 760mm Non-Slip Square Shower Tray with Black Waste
product.description:
The Podium Raised 760 x 760mm non-slip square shower tray is designed for safe and convenient showering, featuring a raised profile for easy installation in a variety of bathrooms. Supplied in white, this tray measures 760mm by 760mm and stands 140mm high, making it suitable for compact spaces or where a square footprint is required. In the box, you will find the shower tray itself along with a matching black centre edge waste kit with a 90mm waste diameter, supporting efficient water removal at up to 32 litres per minute. The tray is crafted from robust acrylic capped ABS, offering both lightness and strength, and incorporates a textured, non-slip surface for added safety. This material not only makes the tray significantly lighter than traditional stone resin but also allows for easier handling and installation, often by a single person. The tray can be cut to fit unusual corners, although care should be taken with cut edges to ensure they remain waterproof. Its universal design ensures compatibility with most shower enclosures and glass screens. Manufactured in the UK using WRAS-approved, phthalate-free components, this tray also comes with the assurance of a 25-year manufacturer's warranty for long-term use.
